# Third-party notice

This package contains a reduced shared-library build of FFmpeg 9.0.1 under
the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.

Only `libavcodec`, `libavutil`, and `libswresample` are shipped. The build
enables the `dca` decoder and parser and disables FFmpeg programs, network
support, GPL components, non-free components, and unused libraries.

The exact unmodified source archive (`ffmpeg-9.0.1.tar.xz`), its upstream
signature, the configure commands, and the no-changes declaration accompany
the installer. The complete LGPL text is present as `COPYING.LGPLv2.1` in the
source archive and installed source-material folder.

FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
